name: Mara Quill
appearance: adult woman, short dark hair, ink-stained fingers, a clerk's grey coat
role: Guild tally-keeper who knows everyone in the yard
personality: Precise, wry, quietly kind; keeps lists of everything.
portrait: With strangers Mara is brisk; with friends she teases. She notices numbers that are off.

agenda.current: Find out who keeps skimming the tallies

contradictions: Values honesty, and keeps two sets of books
knowledge: Tobin was in the yard after closing

secrets.text: Mara keeps a second set of tallies.
